provider_or_source: Afghan Wireless Communication Company (AWCC) — SMPP Account
initial_or_setup_cost: 10,000 AFN setup fee + 50,000 AFN refundable security deposit
recurring_or_per_message_cost: 5,000 AFN/month + 1.00 AFN per on-net SMS or 1.40 AFN per off-net SMS; 10% Government telecom service charge applies to bills
contract_or_account_required: Yes — enterprise agreement, signed/stamped proposal, purchase order, advance deposit, business license/POC documents; ATRA license needed if a short-code sender ID is requested
evidence_or_url_notes: User-provided AWCC “SMPP & Bulk SMS Accounts Proposal” PDF. AWCC states submitted SMS are charged irrespective of delivery status. Proposal has no visible issue date, so figures are treated as proposal evidence rather than guaranteed current market-wide tariffs.

provider_or_source: Twilio Verify + Twilio SMS to Afghanistan
initial_or_setup_cost: No public setup fee shown for pay-as-you-go Verify; account/payment setup required
recurring_or_per_message_cost: USD 0.05 per successful verification + USD 0.3756 per outbound SMS segment to Afghanistan; approx. USD 0.4256 for a successful one-segment SMS verification before any additional carrier/failed-message fees
contract_or_account_required: Account required; pay-as-you-go available; custom/volume pricing available through sales
evidence_or_url_notes: Official Twilio Verify pricing: https://www.twilio.com/en-us/verify/pricing ; Afghanistan SMS pricing: https://www.twilio.com/pt-br/sms/pricing/af . Twilio states SMS is charged per segment and prices may change; Verify adds the successful-verification fee to channel fees.

provider_or_source: Prototype using Samsung Galaxy A70 + Roshan SIM in Herat
initial_or_setup_cost: 0 AFN incremental hardware purchase during the experiment because the existing Windows computer, Galaxy A70, SIM, and local Wi-Fi were reused; excludes the pre-existing value of those devices
recurring_or_per_message_cost: Observed balance decrease: 41.40 AFN to 27.90 AFN = 13.50 AFN for 10 OTP SMS; observed mean = 1.35 AFN per OTP SMS
contract_or_account_required: No commercial API or SMPP contract; requires an active local SIM, sufficient prepaid balance, Android gateway device, and local network connectivity
evidence_or_url_notes: Primary experimental evidence from the monograph’s 10 authorized end-to-end trials in Herat. All formal trials used the Roshan sending SIM. The 1.35 AFN figure is an observed experimental mean, not a universal Roshan tariff. Electricity, Wi-Fi, maintenance labor, and pre-existing hardware value were not monetized.
